system.installTime: 8 hrs per level/Vehicle B/R(levels+2; drones and hovercraft levels+3; electric aircraft levels+4)
system.description: Methane, gasoline or diesel engines (superconductive drive: electric). Speed +15, Acceleration +1 and Signature −1 a level; Economy −5% a level. Aircraft cannot be turbocharged unless electric. The new maximum Speed is 1.5 × the vehicle's (one level always allowed). Parts: 10% of the vehicle's list cost a level. R3R p.126.
